answer: A decentralized economy of AI agents can achieve robust Sybil resistance by anchoring identity generation to a verifiable computational cost, functioning similarly to an immutable system thread that binds every execution kernel to cryptographic proof-of-work. To prevent malicious actors from flooding the network with cheap, unauthorized replicas, each new agent registration requires burning a scarce native asset—metaphorically valued like precious saffron—which imposes a compounding economic penalty on attackers attempting to spawn fake identities at scale.
